description: Controls when TmChat scrolls the message list to the bottom on its own (FZE-6). The default is WhenAtBottom — the only documented change of TmChat's default behavior (the pre-2.10 ScrollToBottomAsync was a no-op); hosts that need the old behavior opt out with Never.

values.name: Never
values.description: Never scrolls on its own — the pre-2.10 behavior. No scrollToBottom, no position preservation and no unread counting: the host owns every scroll (the public ScrollToBottomAsync / ScrollToMessageAsync helpers still work when called explicitly, and the jump-to-new button does not render).

values.name: WhenAtBottom
values.description: Scrolls to the bottom on the first render and afterwards only while the user is actually reading at the bottom (the chat.js scroller reports the at-bottom state). Messages arriving while the user reads above the bottom are counted behind the jump-to-new button instead of stealing the reading position; the user's OWN messages always scroll. A prepend of older history never scrolls — the visual position is preserved.

values.name: Always
values.description: Scrolls to the bottom on every message change, regardless of the reading position (pinned-bottom chats, e.g. a moderated Q&A wall). Older history is not preserved — a prepend scrolls to the bottom too.
